## Important Notes

⚠️ **When You Edit Memories:**
1. Edit master copy in `docs/skill_agent/ai-agents-skills/...`
2. Copy to `.github/skills/` and `.claude/skills/`
3. Restart IDE

⚠️ **Detailed vs Template:**
- **Detailed services** (10): ready to use, full info
- **Template services** (47): fill in as you work, replace `[TODO]`

⚠️ **Common Pattern:**
When you work on a new service:
1. Load its memory: `@gameserver Show {SERVICE}_MEMORY`
2. Fill in missing `[TODO]` items
3. Save and sync
4. Next time you work on same service, memory is complete
